Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 3  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made an error by incorrectly identifying King Edward VII as the King responsible for the 1925 Birthday Honours. King George V was the reigning monarch in 1925, not King Edward VII. This mistake led the subsequent steps to focus on the wrong king, resulting in the wrong birth year being identified.
